provenance.fieldTransfer: Pressure/shear: area-weighted adjacent cells -> original points -> retained vertices. Sensitivity: upstream 20-step smoothed point field.
provenance.forceConvention: Upstream sum A*(p*n_inward - wallShear), n_inward=-VTK cell normal. Raw signed Fx > 0 on this sample; displayed drag D=Fx. Full source mesh, not reduced display mesh.

reduction.limitation: Display approximation. Small features/extrema can be omitted; forces use every original cell.
reduction.method: VTK DecimatePro; preserve topology; retained original vertices

provenance.sensitivityConvention: Batch-corrected partial d(-Fx)/dX at geometry cell centroids; other model inputs held fixed. Not the total mesh derivative. Displayed smoothed normal projection, N/m. Candidate prediction uses separate full-pipeline finite differences.
